menuLabel.en: Real-match reconstruction (anonymized, positions estimated from video)

competition.zh: 真實職業比賽（已匿名化）

subline.zh: 匿名化的真實比賽重建 · 球隊、球員與比分為化名或示範值
subline.en: ANONYMIZED REAL-MATCH RECONSTRUCTION · NAMES AND SCORE REPLACED

coordinates.units: normalized pitch (105 x 68 m assumed); estimated from broadcast frames

sources.label: Broadcast footage of a real professional match (not included; used only to estimate positions). Teams, players, kits and score are anonymized.

rights: Anonymized. No broadcast footage, crest, kit or player likeness is included. Positions and timing are estimates derived from footage.
limitations: Positions are estimates from broadcast frames with unmeasured real-world error, not tracking data
Players outside the camera view, including both goalkeepers in most frames, are not drawn
Ball positions follow the player in possession at event times; the ball itself is not tracked
Real-match identities are anonymized; role labels only

footer.zh: 匿名化真實比賽 · 影片校準估計位置 · 看不到的球員不顯示
footer.en: ANONYMIZED REAL MATCH · POSITIONS ESTIMATED FROM VIDEO · UNSEEN PLAYERS HIDDEN

zh: 這是一個匿名化的真實比賽重建：球員位置與時間來自一場真實職業比賽的轉播畫面估計，但球隊名稱、球衣顏色、球員名稱、號碼與比分都已替換。它不是合成資料。
位置由程式估計：先用球場標線校準每張畫面，再偵測球員腳底換算到球場平面，每 0.5 秒一筆。實際誤差沒有獨立量測；鏡頭外的球員（包括大部分時間的兩隊門將）不顯示。球的位置依事件時間放在持球者腳下。
解說由人工撰寫，沒有接入 AI。動畫不測量速度、空間面積或個人功勞比例，也不證明球員的主觀意圖。專案沒有收錄或發布任何轉播畫面。
en: This is an anonymized reconstruction of a real match: positions and timing are estimated from broadcast footage of a real professional match, but team names, kits, player names, shirt numbers and the score are replaced. It is not synthetic data.

Positions are estimated by software: each frame is calibrated to the pitch markings and players' foot points are projected onto the pitch, every 0.5 s. Real-world error is not independently measured; players out of view, including both goalkeepers most of the time, are not drawn. The ball is placed at the feet of the player in possession at event times.
Explanations are hand-written; no AI is connected. The replay does not measure speed, space or credit and does not establish intent. No broadcast footage is included or republished.

sub.zh: 近側短傳 → 往後重新組織

text.zh: 琥珀 FC 在近側傳遞，附近有石岩聯球員防守。球接著回到後方。
text.en: Amber circulate on the near side with Slate defenders nearby, then return the ball to a deeper teammate.

text.zh: 回傳保留球權，也讓持球者重新選擇進攻方向。
text.en: Recycling retains possession and gives the team a new direction to explore.

text.zh: 球離開原本的局部對抗，後方隊友接手組織。
text.en: The ball leaves the local pressure and a deeper teammate takes over.

text.zh: 近側接球點附近存在防守壓力，進攻並未直接穿過該側，而是重新回到後場。
text.en: Pressure surrounds the near-side receiving options. The sequence returns to deeper positions rather than breaking through that side.

text.zh: 回收球權提供新的出球角度；這不等於證明球隊刻意誘使對手前壓。
text.en: Recycling offers a new passing angle. It does not establish that drawing the opposition forward was a deliberate plan.

text.zh: 後方接球者如何承接球權，以及另一側是否仍有接應選項。
text.en: Watch how the deeper player receives and whether the opposite flank remains available.

insight.zh: 別只追著球向前看：讓進攻繼續的人，也在做貢獻。
insight.en: Keeping an attack alive is a contribution, too.

evidence.zh: 依完整錄影：後場 B 持球推進，傳給近側隊友；該隊友帶球後再傳向邊線，球最後回到退到中線附近的後場 B。位置：從轉播畫面以球場標線校準後偵測球員腳底換算，每 0.5 秒一筆；看不到的球員不顯示。
evidence.en: From the full recording: Builder B carries and passes to a near-side teammate, who carries and passes wider; the ball comes back to Builder B near halfway. Positions: foot points detected in broadcast frames calibrated to the pitch markings, every 0.5 s; players out of view are not drawn.

evidenceRefs.note: boundaries read from the on-screen clock, about ±0.5 s

note.zh: 動作順序已用完整錄影逐格核對；位置為影片估計值，實際誤差未經獨立量測。
note.en: Sequence checked frame by frame against the full recording; positions are video estimates whose real-world error has not been independently measured.

sub.zh: 後方接應 → 中央持球推進

text.zh: 球經後方轉到較中央的隊友，接球者帶球向前。
text.en: The ball moves through a deeper teammate to a more central player, who carries forward.

text.zh: 他把回傳變成新的推進，讓前方隊友有機會再次接應。
text.en: He turns a recycled pass into another advance, reconnecting with teammates ahead.

text.zh: 新的持球位置，接上了遠側邊路的傳球選項。
text.en: The new ball position connects the attack to the far-side option.

text.zh: 後方轉移後出現持球推進。遠側球員仍在寬的位置提供接應。
text.en: A deeper transfer is followed by a carry. The far-side player stays wide as an outlet.

text.zh: 推進與橫向轉移共同改變出球位置。這位球員的貢獻可以具體追溯，不必用虛構的功勞百分比表示。
text.en: The carry and transfer change the origin of the next pass. This contribution is traceable without assigning invented credit percentages.

text.zh: 此示意不計算突破幾道防線或精確推進距離；需要校正座標才能量化。
text.en: Lines broken and exact progression distance are not quantified here; calibrated coordinates would be required.

insight.zh: 沒有進球或助攻，仍可以是進攻的連接者。
insight.en: A player can connect the attack without a goal or assist.

evidence.zh: 依完整錄影：後場 B 把球傳給較中央的隊友，該隊友帶球推進。帶球者在中線附近有數秒偵測不到，位置由人工標註與內插補上。位置：從轉播畫面以球場標線校準後偵測球員腳底換算，每 0.5 秒一筆；看不到的球員不顯示。
evidence.en: From the full recording: Builder B passes inside and the receiver carries forward. The carrier is missed by detection for a few seconds near halfway; those positions are hand-marked or interpolated. Positions: foot points detected in broadcast frames calibrated to the pitch markings, every 0.5 s; players out of view are not drawn.

evidenceRefs.note: boundaries read from the on-screen clock, about ±0.5 s

note.zh: 動作順序已用完整錄影逐格核對；位置為影片估計值，實際誤差未經獨立量測。
note.en: Sequence checked frame by frame against the full recording; positions are video estimates whose real-world error has not been independently measured.

sub.zh: 遠側接球 → 調整接應位置

text.zh: 球送到遠側邊路，附近的石岩聯球員向持球側調整。
text.en: The ball reaches the far flank and nearby Slate players adjust toward that side.

text.zh: 持球者現在可以從邊路觀察禁區內的接應。
text.en: The ball carrier can now look for a receiving run into the box from a wide angle.

text.zh: 前插接應者與 後插射門者開始形成不同深度的接應位置。
text.en: The advanced runner and the trailing finisher begin to offer receiving positions at different depths.

text.zh: 邊路接球後，鄰近防守球員移位；兩位前場球員的相對位置也改變。
text.en: The wide reception is followed by local defensive adjustments and changing positions of the two forwards.

text.zh: 寬度提供傳入禁區的角度，但不能僅憑遠側站位，就認定其他無球者成功牽制了特定防守者。
text.en: Width supplies an angle into the box. A distant position alone does not prove that an off-ball player pinned a particular defender.

text.zh: 同時觀察 前插接應者的啟動與 後插射門者的位置，不要只跟隨持球者。
text.en: Watch the advanced runner’s movement and the trailing finisher’s position alongside the ball carrier.

insight.zh: 現在先找 前插接應者和 後插射門者，再看球。
insight.en: Find the advanced runner and the trailing finisher before following the ball.

evidence.zh: 依完整錄影：球轉向遠側，遠側邊線附近的球員持球。遠側是誰先觸球無法從畫面確定。位置：從轉播畫面以球場標線校準後偵測球員腳底換算，每 0.5 秒一筆；看不到的球員不顯示。
evidence.en: From the full recording: the ball goes to the far side, where a player near the touchline has it. Who touched it first cannot be resolved from the frames. Positions: foot points detected in broadcast frames calibrated to the pitch markings, every 0.5 s; players out of view are not drawn.

evidenceRefs.note: boundaries read from the on-screen clock, about ±0.5 s

note.zh: 主要動作已用完整錄影核對，但遠側第一次觸球者無法確定；位置為影片估計值。
note.en: Main actions checked against the full recording, but the first far-side touch cannot be resolved; positions are video estimates.

sub.zh: 傳入禁區 → 前插接應者深入接應
sub.en: Ball into the box → the advanced runner runs deeper

text.zh: 邊路球員送出空中傳球，前插接應者向禁區深處接應，防守者跟隨。
text.en: A lofted delivery finds the advanced runner running deeper into the box, with a defender following.

text.zh: 前插接應者提供前方接球點，後插射門者從較後的位置跟進。
text.en: The advanced runner offers the advanced receiving point while the trailing finisher follows from behind.

text.zh: 兩人沒有跑到同一個位置，接球後仍可能把球交回後方。
text.en: Their staggered positions preserve the possibility of a layoff behind the first receiver.

text.zh: 傳球送出時，前插接應者的接應深度大於 後插射門者；跟防者隨 前插接應者往禁區內移動。
text.en: At delivery, the advanced runner is the deeper receiver and the trailing finisher follows. A defender tracks the advanced runner into the area.

text.zh: 這種前後錯位能提供二次接應。不需要假設跑動是預設套路，也能描述它實際提供的選項。
text.en: Staggering offers a second receiving point. The available option can be described without claiming a rehearsed routine.

text.zh: 約 17:42：同時標出 前插接應者、跟防者與 後插射門者，檢查他們的相對位置。
text.en: Around 17:42: inspect the relative positions of the advanced runner, the tracking defender and the trailing finisher.

insight.zh: 看清楚：後插射門者沒有和 前插接應者擠在同一個接球點。
insight.en: Notice how the trailing finisher avoids crowding the advanced runner’s receiving point.

evidence.zh: 依完整錄影：遠側球員挑傳入禁區，前插接應者在禁區內接球，防守者在旁。拋物線只表示空中球，不是實測球高。位置：從轉播畫面以球場標線校準後偵測球員腳底換算，每 0.5 秒一筆；看不到的球員不顯示。
evidence.en: From the full recording: the far-side player lofts the ball into the box; the advanced runner receives with a defender beside him. The arc only marks an aerial ball, not a measured height. Positions: foot points detected in broadcast frames calibrated to the pitch markings, every 0.5 s; players out of view are not drawn.

evidenceRefs.note: boundaries read from the on-screen clock, about ±0.5 s

note.zh: 動作順序已用完整錄影逐格核對；位置為影片估計值，實際誤差未經獨立量測。
note.en: Sequence checked frame by frame against the full recording; positions are video estimates whose real-world error has not been independently measured.

title.zh: 回做，把機會交給下一人。

sub.zh: 前插接應者回做 → 後插射門者帶球射門
sub.en: The advanced runner lays off → the trailing finisher carries & finishes

text.zh: 前插接應者在防守者貼近時回做，後插射門者跟進接球，帶球幾步後射門。
text.en: With a defender close, the advanced runner lays the ball back. The trailing finisher follows, receives, takes a few touches and shoots.

text.zh: 球從前方接應者交給後方隊友，進攻由下一位球員接手。
text.en: The advanced receiver transfers the attack to his supporting teammate.

text.zh: 防守者再嘗試封堵，後插射門者完成這次進攻。
text.en: Defenders attempt to close the shot as the trailing finisher completes the attack.

text.zh: 前插接應者的回做改變球的方向，後插射門者接球後帶球進入禁區射門，附近防守者向射門點移動。
text.en: The advanced runner redirects the ball; the trailing finisher receives, carries into the area and shoots as nearby defenders move toward the finishing point.

text.zh: 前後接應在此形成實際連結。射門機會同時涉及進攻配合與防守反應，不能只歸因於一個跑動。
text.en: The staggered positions now connect. The chance reflects both attacking coordination and defensive responses, not a single run alone.

text.zh: 回傳、後方推進、邊路傳球、深入接應和回做，共同串成這個進球。
text.en: Recycling, progression, wide delivery, a deeper run and the layoff connect into the goal.

insight.zh: 記得射門，也記得把球送到這裡的人。
insight.en: Remember the finish — and the players who made it possible.

evidence.zh: 依完整錄影：回做之後，後插射門者接球、帶球幾步後射門。位置：從轉播畫面以球場標線校準後偵測球員腳底換算，每 0.5 秒一筆；看不到的球員不顯示。
evidence.en: From the full recording: after the layoff, the trailing finisher receives, takes a few touches and shoots. Positions: foot points detected in broadcast frames calibrated to the pitch markings, every 0.5 s; players out of view are not drawn.

evidenceRefs.note: boundaries read from the on-screen clock, about ±0.5 s

note.zh: 動作順序已用完整錄影逐格核對；位置為影片估計值，實際誤差未經獨立量測。
note.en: Sequence checked frame by frame against the full recording; positions are video estimates whose real-world error has not been independently measured.

title.zh: 進球背後，還有這些貢獻。
title.en: More than a name on the scoresheet.

intro.zh: 從保住球權到完成射門，每一段都有可觀察的參與。這裡呈現的是角色貢獻，不是功勞排名。
intro.en: From retaining possession to the finish, every phase has observable contributions. These are roles, not a ranking of credit.

text.zh: 承接回傳，重新把球推向前方。
text.en: Receive the recycle and reconnect the attack.

text.zh: 把球送向 前插接應者的接應位置。
text.en: Deliver the ball toward the advanced runner’s receiving run.

text.zh: 深入接應，再把球回做給隊友。
text.en: Receive deeper, then lay the ball off.

text.zh: 從後方跟進，把接應轉化為射門。
text.en: Follow the play and turn support into a shot.

positionMethod.summary: Homography per frame from pitch markings, colour-based player detection, tracking, manual role mapping and a few hand-marked points, sampled every 0.5 s (scripts/video/).
